name: @fireback/js-remote-ctx
description: Framework-agnostic runtime shared by every generated fireback SDK module - fetch/WebSocket/SSE wrappers, response envelopes, and the React hooks (useFetchx/useSse/useWebSocketX) actions bind to. This is the single copy `make defs` (emi's `js:sdk` target) writes to; the per-module SDKs generated straight into ui-core/manage/selfservice/messaging's own sdk/ folders (see ui/packages/README.md) only reference it, they never embed their own.
